calls.title: Remy & James
calls.summary: The discussions focused on resolving ambiguities in the employment contract, particularly between the labor portage and consultant models, with Rémy Marin awaiting legal advice. Key points included the contract's duration and start date, with a tentative start planned for July 27th, depending on legal feedback. Concerns were raised about the separation of base salary and variable remuneration, which is crucial for employee motivation and retention. Legal issues regarding confidentiality clauses were also highlighted, given the differences between U.S. and French law. Onboarding preparation, coordination with technical support, and access challenges on the Rippling platform were addressed to ensure smooth integration into Growth Book.
calls.keywords: Rippling, EOR contract, labor portage model, prospecting obligations, variable remuneration, legal review
